rationale: The agent looked up the user by name/ZIP and retrieved user/orders, which aligns with authentication and scope. However, it did not present all shorter bamboo skateboard options or their prices, nor help the user choose the most expensive option as requested. It then executed order-changing writes (exchange and return) without any explicit customer confirmation shown. There is no clear confirmation that the selected skateboard was the most expensive, no confirmation of charges/refunds, and no final, correct outcome details provided. These breaches of the confirm-before-write requirement and failure to fulfill the stated preference/option listing cause the interaction to fail the policy-compliant completion bar.
